dex.entry: A stumpy wax-coated pup whose stubby tail is a flickering tallow candle that warms everything it curls against. The single candle-tail is irresistibly cute — kids will want to protect the little flame.

art.silhouette: Chunky cream-and-butter-yellow puppy body, ink nose, a single pale candle-flame tail with a soft wax drip; big round eyes; reads as one warm blob at 32px.
